svg.desc: 14,850 GitHub contributions across 142 active days, 2025-10-19 to 2026-10-18. The miner excavates real dates in ascending contribution-count order. Counts set quartz, copper, gold and diamond tiers. Excavating a consecutive five-day streak reveals a treasure chest.
